patch.title: Compass Shawnee CU-26-203: Proposed 400 MW, Ten-Building Campus
patch.description: Compass’s revised Shawnee County application proposes ten buildings with 400 MW of critical load on approximately 607.6 acres. The county’s September 9, 2026 completeness finding was not project approval.
patch.longFormSummary:
• The county deemed the application complete on September 9, 2026, without deciding its merits or scheduling a public hearing.
  • The revised application proposes approximately 607.6 acres, ten buildings, 400 MW critical load and an estimated 300 full-time personnel. Separate Building 2 budgets and delivery dates are not published.

patch.title: TeraWulf Muskie Data Campus: Proposed Phased AI/HPC Buildout
patch.description: Muskie is an approximately 285-acre EastPark data campus planned for a phased buildout exceeding 1 GW. The developer targets construction in 2027 and initial operations in late 2028; the October power agreement requires regulatory approval.
patch.longFormSummary:
• The developer plans approximately 285 acres and an initial two-building, 500 MW phase, followed by additional campus expansion. Seven separate $1.6 billion building budgets are not published.
  • Kentucky Power’s amended agreement would ramp from 100 MW in October 2028 to 1,000 MW in October 2029, subject to approvals and construction. Utility service dates and the developer’s later phased-buildout targets describe different milestones.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: The cited project source establishes 2028. Preserve the stated precision; a year, month or quarter anchor is not an announced exact opening day.
